description: Every target sheet ever generated, with the block of marker ids it owns. A serial is printed at the foot of each cut piece so a piece off the disc can say which sheet it came from; the measurements for each print live in prints/<serial>.json.

reserved_ids.0-15: ref_1, issued before serials existed -- overlaps charuco_0001 and must never share a frame with it
reserved_ids.note: RESERVED_IDS in bin/make-peg-targets is 40; new sheets start above this range.

dictionary_budget.nested: Every DICT_6X6_250 marker is the identical pattern at the identical id in DICT_6X6_1000, measured off the rendered markers, so exhausting the 250 and moving up costs nothing already printed.

issued.note: Issued before this registry existed and backfilled. Its pieces carry no printed serial and its ids collide with charuco_0001. Printed 4.75 per cent undersize; square 11.906 mm. See prints/ref_1.json.
